body.name: Conditional certificate exceptional set
body.construction: Assume \(d_e(G)<\infty\), a valid source-prime chart package \(\mathfrak C_{G,e}\), and the successful finite-output event of \(\mathrm{thm:conditional\mbox{-}geometric\mbox{-}resolution}\). Define \(\mathcal E_{G,e}=V(h_{G,e})=\{\Sigma:h_{G,e}(\Sigma)=0\}\), where \(h_{G,e}\) is the product of the nonzero covariance-localization, incidence-lifting, pole, projective-leading-form, specialized-leading-coefficient, squarefreeness, and real-lifting circuits returned by the conditional algorithm.
